data.title: 200 ms is a hard budget for non-interactive commands; the TUI is exempt and loaded lazily
data.why: From CLAUDE.md; ADR-006 (DOC-9). kadence task add is run dozens of times a day, so every non-interactive command answers inside 200 ms. The TUI is exempt because it starts once and lives for minutes - which is why blessed is imported lazily, and CI greps dist/cli.js to prove it never leaks into the fast path. Timing is re-measured after any change to the core.
data.rejected: Importing the TUI library with the rest of the CLI: its load time would be paid by every task add
